verses.text: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
lines: My cry goes to God!
Indeed, I cry to God for help,
and for him to listen to me.

verses.text: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
lines: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord.
My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired.
My soul refused to be comforted.

verses.text: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
lines: I remember God, and I groan.
I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.

verses.text: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
lines: You hold my eyelids open.
I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

verses.text: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
lines: I have considered the days of old,
the years of ancient times.

verses.text: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
lines: I remember my song in the night.
I consider in my own heart;
my spirit diligently inquires:

verses.text: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
lines: “Will the Lord reject us forever?
Will he be favorable no more?

verses.text: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
lines: Has his loving kindness vanished forever?
Does his promise fail for generations?

verses.text: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?”
lines: Has God forgotten to be gracious?
Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?”

verses.text: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
lines: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this:
the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

verses.text: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
lines: I will remember Yah’s deeds;
for I will remember your wonders of old.

verses.text: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
lines: I will also meditate on all your work,
and consider your doings.

verses.text: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
lines: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary.
What god is great like God?

verses.text: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
lines: You are the God who does wonders.
You have made your strength known among the peoples.

verses.text: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph.
lines: You have redeemed your people with your arm,
the sons of Jacob and Joseph.

verses.text: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
lines: The waters saw you, God.
The waters saw you, and they writhed.
The depths also convulsed.

verses.text: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
lines: The clouds poured out water.
The skies resounded with thunder.
Your arrows also flashed around.

verses.text: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
lines: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind.
The lightnings lit up the world.
The earth trembled and shook.

verses.text: Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
lines: Your way was through the sea;
your paths through the great waters.
Your footsteps were not known.

verses.text: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
lines: You led your people like a flock,
by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
